results.title: Celtic 0, Rangers 1: Ryan Naderi clinches win and piles pressure on Martin O'Neill
results.description: A first half Ryan Naderi strike clinched an away victory for Rangers over Celtic at Parkhead today and increased pressure on Martin O'Neill.

results.title: Pakistan thrash Thailand 9-0 in Asian Games hockey opener
results.description: Pakistan thrashed Thailand 9-0 in their Asian Games 2026 hockey opening match in Japan on Sunday, 24News HD TV reported.

results.title: India Shines at Asian Games 2026: Elavenil Valarivan Leads with Silver Medals
results.description: India has made a strong start at the Asian Games 2026, with Elavenil Valarivan leading the charge by winning silver medals in shooting. The women's cricket team also secured a spot in the finals with a commanding victory over Bangladesh. Both hockey teams showcased their prowess with impressive wins, while the badminton and table tennis squads began their campaigns on a high note. However, there were some disappointments in teqball and MMA. Read on to explore the highlights and performances of Indian athletes at this prestigious event.

results.title: MotoGP Austrian GP: Acosta finally claims maiden win
results.description: Pedro Acosta claimed his maiden MotoGP victory with a dominant performance at the Austrian Grand Prix, while Jorge Martin extended his points lead over Marc Marquez with second.
